annualCostSavings.description:
Annual cost savings in currency units:
annualEnergySavingsKwh × electricityPricePerKwh.

simplePaybackYears.description:
Simple payback period in years: repairCost ÷ annualCostSavings. Null when the
annual cost savings are not positive (payback is undefined).

annualEmissionsReductionKg.description:
Annual avoided emissions in kg CO2e:
annualEnergySavingsKwh × emissionsFactorKgPerKwh (0 when no factor supplied).

title:
The computed economics of a single hypothetical {@link RepairScenario}.

A lightweight, non-persisted value type returned by {@link RepairScenario#evaluate}.
Every figure is a **hypothetical scenario based on user-provided assumptions** —
it cannot be derived from a thermal image alone.
name: RepairScenarioResult
